## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check:all` passes locally (typecheck + lint + format + `formulas:validate`)
- [ ] If this adds/edits a formula: all six languages (`es`, `en`, `pt`, `fr`, `zh`, `ja`)
      are filled in — or I've explicitly noted below which ones are missing and why
- [ ] If this touches animation/CSS: it only animates `transform`/`opacity`, and follows
      the monochrome/typographic rules in `SPEC.md`/`DESIGN.md`
- [ ] I ran `pnpm dev` and checked the change in the browser (not just that it builds)
- [ ] Screenshot or short recording attached below, if this is a visual/animation change
